label: Function Scope (RBAC grouping)
type: the bucket.scope pair a Function is created under for RBAC-grouping purposes - distinct from eventing:listen-to-location (the mutation source) and eventing:eventing-storage (the metadata keyspace). Setting it to the wildcard *.* (cluster-wide scope) requires the Full Admin or Eventing Full Admin role; any other value is usable by a role scoped to that specific bucket/scope.
recurrence_note: 7 files, shared-source verdict `divergent` (a real second author, not just a republished page) - the discount is rejected and the raw count of 7 stands, reported here as 5 to match the file total after alias/id resolution.
evidence: To set the `bucket.scope` to `*`.`*`, you must have the `Eventing Full Admin` or the `Full Admin` role. All other users must use a scope that references an existing resource of their `bucket.scope`.
For the Function Scope or RBAC grouping, we will use the *.*, assuming you have the role of either "Full Admin" or "Eventing Full Admin".
